# Lumenloop

> > Lumenloop provides AI-powered lighting specification tools, featuring Loopy, an intelligent assistant for product finding and workflow automation in the lighting industry.

Lumenloop specializes in streamlining lighting specification workflows through artificial intelligence. The platform's core offering, Loopy, enables professionals to match products, analyze documents, and automate specification tasks with conversational AI.

## Key Topics

- Loopy (AI lighting assistant)
- AI product finder
- Lighting specification
- Product matching
- Document analysis
- Workflow automation
- Lighting industry tools
- Specification assistance
- Intelligent search
- Lighting design automation

## AI Tools & Product Finder

- [AI Product Finder](https://lumenloop.co.uk/ai-product-finder): AI-powered lighting finder (Loopy) for specification & product matching
